name: Young Man
source:
A young man who's a regular at Magpie.
He acts strangely for a customer.

[Translated from the [url=https://sakuramint01.kagennotuki.com/applepie/applepie_index.html#character]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]It is later revealed that his name is 小山田 (Oyamada).[/spoiler]
